set.body:
Deliver the retrospective-study journey on a single installation for both finished archives and BIDS deposits.

Acceptance criteria

1. A curator in a new project deposits under a named custodian. A researcher starting from Home can find the permitted release using its description and retrieve the exact files.
2. With R1 shared and R2 private, search results and grant inspection reveal only the permitted scope. A fresh steward session can explain and revoke access.
3. ARC06 records the packaged two-lab rehearsal, including the discovery-only and link-only cases.

Verification

Archive description fixture, two-lab browser receipt and reference/PostgreSQL disclosure tests.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: EP11: Find a deposited study and share one release across labs
